for a model without that rule (Corolla Hybrid) it yields exactly the one URL it builds today; proven by URL-building tests for both cases and by the carvana builder being unchanged\u0022,\u0022The walk visits each of a pair\\u0027s search pages in turn, collecting candidate links from each, and splits the per-pair cap across them (half each, the odd page to the hybrid-facet search) while still stopping the pair at the cap in total; the recorder writes one search text per search (for example search.txt and search-2.txt, or a name that says which facet), and the per-pair summary line and end-of-run table still report the pair as one row; proven by walk tests over the recorded fixtures\u0022,\u0022A walk of a pair with one search behaves exactly as before: same links, same cap, same file names; existing walk, coverage, and summary tests pass\u0022,\u0022The README\\u0027s walk section and the WalkSites class remarks explain the two-search rule; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Reported by run session odonomics-40 on 2026-09-24 during walk run 4 (notes/run-session-2026-09-22.md, Gaps found). cars.com / Toyota Camry Hybrid: 35 pages, 11 saved, 24 dropped (14 wrong model, 10 missing fields). The 14 wrong-model drops are 2019 to 2024 gas Camry LE/SE/XLE/XSE: the single query carries models[]=toyota-camry and models[]=toyota-camry_hybrid with year_min=2018, and cars.com cannot take a different minimum year per model facet, so every gas Camry from 2018 on comes back; under best_match sorting the real Camry Hybrid titles sat at positions 24 and 25 of 35, so the cap of 30 went mostly to gas Camrys that ListingQuery.MatchesExtractedVehicle then rejected. The 10 missing-fields drops were the new-car block PR #39 already fixes. Recorded page: ~/Library/Application Support/Odonomics/walks/cars.com/20260925-021026/camry-hybrid/search.txt. Code: WalkSite in src/Odonomics/Walk/WalkSites.cs has one BuildSearchUrl per site (Func\\u003CListingQuery, string\\u003E); the walk loop is WalkPairAsync in src/Odonomics/Cli/Commands/WalkCommand.cs (one search page, one link pool of maxDetailPages times DetailLinkOverfetchMultiplier, one recorder per pair writing search.txt); the hybrid-only rule is ListingQuery.HybridOnlyFromModelYear in src/Odonomics/Sources/ListingQuery.cs, and the class remarks on WalkSites explain why the base-model facet is queried at all. Make BuildSearchUrl return one or more URLs rather than adding a cars.com special case in the command. Main is past PR #39 (new-car cards skipped at link collection; SkippedCardTitlePattern), so build on that.
